stemMd: A trapezoid has parallel sides 8 cm and 14 cm and height 5 cm. What is its area?
explanationMd: Trapezoid area is the average of the parallel sides times height: (8 + 14)/2 × 5 = 11 × 5 = 55 cm². The result lies between the areas 40 and 70 of rectangles using either base.

distractorRationale.c: This omits division by two in averaging the parallel sides.
distractorRationale.e: This uses only the shorter parallel side.
distractorRationale.b: This uses only the longer parallel side.
distractorRationale.d: This uses the difference of the parallel sides rather than their average.
